scope_notes: Full suites excluded by the unit brief (measurement tooling only).
Commit, peer review, inspection handoff and publication belong to the design owner.

The initial existing-Python run failed the historical live-tool hash comparison; it now validates the unchanged recorded hashes against the original revision-7 integration snapshot, with current-tool provenance separately covered.

The optional import bootstrap generated both new script .uid sidecars before timing out in the large historical art tree. It was not used as parser proof and was not retried. The sidecar guard passed; no tracked asset/import settings changed.
Attempting to interrupt the optional import runner returned: zsh:kill:1: kill 87962 failed: operation not permitted. Its own 300-second runner timeout subsequently terminated it.
The Skybolt domain assertions are called by the registered encounter_measurement_test.gd suite. The focused wrapper shares those assertions; no shared manifest edits are required.

Primary-only Shock is an explicit director decision. An offline-only adapter now suppresses Shock on conducted targets for V1/V5; production carries shock:1 regardless of the flag. Five pre-adapter arm checkpoints are being replaced by complete fresh runs. Each valid V1/V5 result records primary_only_shock_adapter:true; resume/report validation rejects pre-adapter results.

The initial sweep freezes its tooling hashes and will intentionally invalidate its final report after this adapter change. After all checkpoint corrections finish, replay/resume every completed checkpoint under the final tools to validate sampling and generate the final report; no stale report will be handed off.

The generic duplicate-card override creates one private in-memory prototype, excluded from rewards, so preset copies retain their complete original definition. Its namespace is technical only. The initial new regression compared a raw definition to a resolved combat definition (id/action metadata); the check now compares resolved definitions against the native engine and separately verifies raw data/file identity.

Conducted-hit keyword source_pos is a force/hop origin. The collector now tracks the actual pre-cast origin. Old nonzero-cast records are selectively replayed; every outcome/turn/HP/kill/decision/preview field and every non-geometric usage counter must match exactly before only range/LOS counters are replaced. Zero-cast records retain all numerical values. origin_metric:caster_v1 identifies corrected counters. Per-file leases serialize refresh with concurrent resume validation.

The first sweep correctly refused to generate a report after tool updates: RuntimeError: Tool changed during measurement: encounter_measurement_bot.gd. All corrected checkpoints are being revalidated by a fresh final-tool run; the obsolete report was never generated.

The new duplicate-copy regression initially failed: SKYBOLT OVERRIDES: FAIL (37 checks; 1 failures). Its raw-versus-resolved comparison was corrected; the native engine control, separate raw definition check, actual card payment, and byte-identical source checks now pass.

Final-tool checkpoint validation and report generation completed successfully after every correction and metric refresh. The earlier tooling-hash invalidation is resolved; all final hashes match current sources. All headless processes are finished.
